core_meaning.primary_meaning: Habeeb is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Beloved, darling”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Habeeb corresponds to the Arabic form حبيب (Arabic root ح ب ب (ḥ-b-b); حبيب (Ḥabīb)). Its core sense is beloved, dear one. Habeeb is Arabic حبيب (Ḥabīb) 'beloved, darling', from the root ح ب ب (ḥ-b-b). The source gloss 'beloved or loved one' is correct. It is the same name as habib in this batch.
